concert_PackageVulnerability.risk_score.justification: Risk scores and major severity breakdowns are conceptually linked through their quantification of issue severity.
Risk scores and minor severity breakdowns are related as they both deal with the assessment of issue impact.
Risk scores and critical severity breakdowns are related as they both assess the severity of issues.
Risk scores and normal severity breakdowns are conceptually linked through their assessment of lower-severity issues.
